prs.cluster_pick_reason: #2032's `_should_pre_parse_json` calls `get_origin(annotation)` directly and checks it against the union origin marker; this only matches a bare `str | None`. For the common `Annotated[str | None, Field(description=...)]` pattern (typical for described tool parameters), `get_origin` on an Annotated alias returns the wrapped union value itself rather than the `types.UnionType`/`typing.Union` marker, so the union check fails and falls through to `return True` — the original corruption bug persists for annotated params. #3056 adds `_unwrap_annotated()` and applies it before the union check in `_is_optional_str`, so it correctly detects and fixes both plain and Annotated-wrapped `str | None` params. #2032's fix is broader in one respect (it also skips pre-parsing for other all-simple-type unions like `str | int`), but that behavior change isn't covered by the bug this cluster is about and isn't validated by either diff's test additions shown here.

clusters.pick_reason: #2032's `_should_pre_parse_json` calls `get_origin(annotation)` directly and checks it against the union origin marker; this only matches a bare `str | None`. For the common `Annotated[str | None, Field(description=...)]` pattern (typical for described tool parameters), `get_origin` on an Annotated alias returns the wrapped union value itself rather than the `types.UnionType`/`typing.Union` marker, so the union check fails and falls through to `return True` — the original corruption bug persists for annotated params. #3056 adds `_unwrap_annotated()` and applies it before the union check in `_is_optional_str`, so it correctly detects and fixes both plain and Annotated-wrapped `str | None` params. #2032's fix is broader in one respect (it also skips pre-parsing for other all-simple-type unions like `str | int`), but that behavior change isn't covered by the bug this cluster is about and isn't validated by either diff's test additions shown here.

members.author: AydarAkhmetzyanov
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2666: Race condition in streamable_http.py's post_writer: the task that writes POST requests to the server doesn't signal readiness before the caller proceeds (e.g., starting the GET/SSE stream or yielding control), so messages can be sent/dropped before post_writer's read loop is actually listening. clusters.pick_reason: #2032's `_should_pre_parse_json` calls `get_origin(annotation)` directly and checks it against the union origin marker; this only matches a bare `str | None`. For the common `Annotated[str | None, Field(description=...)]` pattern (typical for described tool parameters), `get_origin` on an Annotated alias returns the wrapped union value itself rather than the `types.UnionType`/`typing.Union` marker, so the union check fails and falls through to `return True` — the original corruption bug persists for annotated params. #3056 adds `_unwrap_annotated()` and applies it before the union check in `_is_optional_str`, so it correctly detects and fixes both plain and Annotated-wrapped `str | None` params. #2032's fix is broader in one respect (it also skips pre-parsing for other all-simple-type unions like `str | int`), but that behavior change isn't covered by the bug this cluster is about and isn't validated by either diff's test additions shown here.

members.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs edit the exact same two raise sites in utils.py plus session.py. The difference is in the fix itself: #2777 drops the redundant f-string interpolation of `{e}` in the message (e.g. `raise OAuthRegistrationError("Invalid registration response") from e`), since the chained `from e` already surfaces the original exception/traceback — avoiding duplicated error text. #2565 keeps the old f-string message (`f"Invalid registration response: {e}"`) and only appends `from e`, so the original exception's string representation is duplicated both in the new message and in the chain. #2777's title also claims broader coverage ("all except handlers") versus #2565's scoped "12 remaining raise sites".
